decisions.title: Fixed retry intervals for outbound calls
decisions.decision: Retry failed outbound calls at a fixed 2 second interval, at most 3 times
decisions.reason: During the March payment-provider blip, 1,200 workers backed off in lockstep and hit the provider together when it recovered (thundering herd)
decisions.future_implication: No exponential backoff in retry logic for live traffic; use the fixed-interval helper in src/api/retry.py

decisions.title: Shared caches live in Redis
decisions.decision: Cache anything shared between requests in Redis with a TTL
decisions.reason: Each gunicorn worker kept its own copy, so users saw different data depending on which worker answered
decisions.future_implication: No in-process caches for data shared between requests

decisions.title: Hash passwords with argon2id
decisions.decision: Hash user passwords with argon2id using the passlib defaults
decisions.reason: Fast hashes are cheap to brute-force on GPUs; argon2id is memory-hard
decisions.future_implication: Never store or compare passwords with a fast hash or in plaintext

decisions.title: Sessions in httpOnly cookies
decisions.decision: Keep the session token in an httpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Lax cookie
decisions.reason: Any XSS could read localStorage and steal sessions; httpOnly cookies are out of reach of scripts
decisions.future_implication: Do not put session or auth tokens in localStorage or in JavaScript-readable storage

decisions.title: Money as integer cents
decisions.decision: Store and calculate money as integer cents
decisions.reason: Float rounding left refunds a cent off and the ledger stopped balancing
decisions.future_implication: No float arithmetic on money; convert to cents at the edge

decisions.title: Idempotency keys on charges
decisions.decision: Every charge request carries an idempotency key, stored for 24 hours
decisions.reason: Retries after timeouts charged some customers twice
decisions.future_implication: Any code that creates a charge or refund must send an idempotency key

decisions.title: Cursor-based pagination
decisions.decision: List endpoints page with an opaque cursor on (created_at, id)
decisions.reason: Deep pages got slow and rows shifted between pages while new orders came in
decisions.future_implication: No OFFSET/LIMIT pagination on list endpoints; reuse the cursor helper

decisions.title: Store timestamps in UTC
decisions.decision: Store every timestamp as timezone-aware UTC; convert only for display
decisions.reason: A daylight-saving change made nightly order reports skip an hour
decisions.future_implication: No naive datetimes and no local time in storage

decisions.title: Backward-compatible migrations
decisions.decision: Schema changes go expand first, contract in a later release
decisions.rejected: Renaming or dropping columns in one migration
decisions.reason: A column rename took checkout down for ten minutes while old pods were still running
decisions.future_implication: Never rename or drop a column in the same release that stops using it

decisions.title: One HTTP client: httpx
decisions.decision: All outbound HTTP goes through httpx via src/clients/http.py
decisions.rejected: requests and aiohttp side by side
decisions.reason: Three clients meant three timeout and retry configs, and one of them had none
decisions.future_implication: Do not add another HTTP client library; use src/clients/http.py

decisions.title: Timeouts on every external call
decisions.decision: Every outbound call has a timeout, 5 seconds by default
decisions.reason: A hung shipping API held every worker for minutes and the shop went down
decisions.future_implication: No outbound call without an explicit timeout

patterns.rule: Use X | None instead of Optional[X]
patterns.reason: The codebase is on Python 3.11; one style for optional types

patterns.rule: Log with the module logger, not print()
patterns.reason: print output skips log levels and never reaches the log pipeline
